item.title: Hartanah Kenyalang subsidiary secures RM184 mln contract to upgrade Sarawak Stadium
item.description: KUCHING (January 25): Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad’s (Hartanah Kenyalang), wholly-owned subsidiary Hartanah Construction Sdn Bhd, has received a letter of award from the Public Works Department Sarawak to repair and upgrade the Sarawak Stadium for a contract sum of RM184.3 million. The contract period for the repair and upgrade of the stadium is 12 months, effective January 30, 2026 to January 29, 2027. item.description: BENTONG: The Road Transport Department (JPJ) seized six luxury cars estimated to be worth RM1.5 million for various offences during a Special Ops on the East Coast Highway 1 (LPT1) near Karak here, today. item.title: Electric bus schedule adjustments enhance tourist experience in Semenggoh
item.description: KUCHING: The free electric bus schedule to the Semenggoh Wildlife Centre here has been re-adjusted to improve the tourist experience, especially in ensuring punctual arrival for the orangutan feeding session. Sarawak Tourism, Creative Industries and Performing Arts Minister Datuk Seri Abdul Karim Rahman Hamzah said the adjustment was made after it was discovered that the previous schedule had caused some tourists to arrive late, thus missing the opportunity to witness the animal feeding session.
